description: This file defines the ImportFieldSanitize class, which provides methods for sanitizing and validating import data fields such as dates, emails, times, and related fields in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It handles locale formatting, field validation, and sanitization during data import processes.

classes.name: ImportFieldSanitize
classes.description: A class for sanitizing and validating import field values in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, including date, time, email, and related fields handling.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls for field sanitization, delegating to specific SugarField classes based on method name.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Validates and converts date fields according to locale formats.

methods.name: email
methods.description: Validates email address format using a regex.

methods.name: synctooutlook
methods.description: Validates sync_to_outlook field values, ensuring referenced users or teams exist.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Validates and converts time fields, including handling offsets.

methods.name: isValidTimeDate
methods.description: Checks if the date/time value matches expected format and logical constraints.
